_meta.note: Per-million-token pricing in cents. Captain updates on Anthropic price changes. CI test ensures every customer.yaml-declared `model` has a pricing entry. Cited in docs/specs/operator/cost-telemetry-events.md 'Per-call emission (Claude API)'. Existing rows are kept as priced on their model ids; do not reprice history. The A&P medchron pipeline (models.py) defaults every stage to claude-opus-5 / claude-sonnet-5; a missing row prices that whole pipeline at zero.

multipliers._note: Applied on top of the per-token rates by the medchron runner's cents ledger (operator/runners/medchron/medchron/budget.py, ss#2613): batch = Batch API discount on the whole row; cache_write_5m / cache_write_1h = prompt-cache write premiums on the input rate; cache_read = prompt-cache read rate on the input rate. One file prices the seat's cap and the venture's telemetry. A model row may carry its own cache_read_multiplier when its cache-read price is not the table-wide multiple of its input rate (claude-opus-5-5: 0.05); absent means the table-wide value applies.
